task.title: Expose `m3_major_arcana_from_codon` utility
evidence: CODE EXISTS: m3_major_arcana_from_codon() at m3.c:338-355 — written pre-task.
ARCHITECTURAL ISSUE: Function collapses codon→aa→card via amino_acid_index, skipping transcription entirely.
BIMBA MAP: Major Arcana = chromosomes (not amino acids). 22 chr pairs at #3-3-5-0-0 through #3-3-5-0-21.
TRANSCRIPTIONAL BRIDGE: 37 T-containing codons undergo T→U shift; 27 are T-free shared. Current function treats all codons identically.
NEEDS: struct return with card_index + transcriptional_class (DNA-source/RNA-transcribed/shared) + T→U substitution count (0-3, determines 7 vs 8 rotational states).
REDESIGN REQUIRED: kernel invariant change — not a no-orphan-fill. Awaiting Frank's direction.

evidence.text: Scope reduced per design-pass 2026-06-13 (Phase-H session-as-transcription synthesis): the function m3_major_arcana_from_codon at m3.c:338 is a trivial composition (codon -> M3_CODON_TO_AA -> reverse-lookup M3_MAJOR_ARCANA[].amino_acid_index) and works correctly as-is. The "kernel invariant change" originally flagged is the transcript-class + governance helpers — moved to NEW tranche 4.16 (additive to m3.h/m3.c). Closing scope for 19.T19.5: (1) replace the misleading m3.c:330-336 comment with "Map a codon to its Major Arcana card via amino-acid -> chromosome association. Stable under T<->U substitution: DNA and RNA forms of the same codon resolve to the same archetypal territory. Returns 0xFF for STOP codons and amino acids with no autosomal assignment." (2) no kernel-substrate changes — they live in 4.16. Once comment-patched, the function passes the original verification clause (cargo test -p epi-lib m3_major_arcana_from_codon_roundtrip). Ready for claim + close. Cross-link: DR-M3-TRANSCRIPT-1 (PROPOSED) routes the broader kernel work to 4.16 / 4.17 / 5.26 / 5.27.
